description: Na₂Co₂B₁₂O₂₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.76 Å. Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.38 Å. There are six inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-64°. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.53 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.41 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.40 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-62°. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.42-1.58 Å. In the sixth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.35 Å) and two longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Co, and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Co, and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Co, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Co and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent B atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Co and two B atoms.
